stages.title: Pan-compensated second frame
stages.description: The phase-correlation estimate (-11.993, -0.006) px is removed before local flow estimation. Full displacement is restored in the reported vectors.

stages.title: Raw flow before validation
stages.description: Full displacement before texture and round-trip rejection. Hue: right red, down yellow-green, left cyan, up violet. Brightness saturates at 24 px. These estimates include unsupported guesses in flat areas; the next step checks them.

stages.title: Accepted samples
stages.description: White pixels have enough local texture and pass the forward/backward check. This is a validity filter, not a calibrated confidence score.

stages.title: Dense displacement
stages.description: Dense map hue: right red, down yellow-green, left cyan, up violet. Brightness saturates at 24 px. Black can mean zero motion or rejected data; inspect the validity mask.

stages.title: Result
stages.description:
Dominant image translation: dx -11.998, dy -0.005 px.
53 / 70 grid regions measured; 9.2% of pixels pass checks. Vectors describe total input-to-second displacement.
Arrows start on the first image. Labels are rounded dx,dy; inspect for precise values. Arrow display multiplier 1× does not change measured values. Dots mark near-zero motion; grey crosses mean insufficient evidence.
Dense map hue: right red, down yellow-green, left cyan, up violet. Brightness saturates at 24 px. Black can mean zero motion or rejected data; inspect the validity mask.

input.title: First frame
input.description: Synthetic rectified left view with three textured planes. Their disparities are 8, 16 and 24 px; larger disparity means nearer depth.

second.title: Second frame
second.description: Synthetic right view. The three planes shift left by 8, 16 and 24 px, while staying on the same rows. Occlusion and unmatched borders can produce invalid disparities.

stages.title: Rectified grayscale pair
stages.description: Left and right grayscale views must already have corresponding points on the same rows. This recipe assumes rectification; it does not calibrate cameras.

stages.title: Disparity
stages.description: Positive disparity is horizontal displacement in pixels. Negative values are invalid.

stages.title: Valid disparities
stages.description: White marks positive disparities eligible for depth conversion. Black is invalid or nonpositive, not a measured zero distance.

stages.title: Result
stages.description: 118381 positive-depth samples. Calibration assumptions determine the units and accuracy. Synthetic plane depth medians (far to near): 6.250, 3.125, 2.083 m with the example calibration. Bright means farther in this normalized depth preview; black is invalid.
